usage: A common countable noun for a place that sells makeup, skincare, and other beauty items. Use it when talking about shopping for cosmetics in everyday Hong Kong Cantonese.
Often appears with verbs like 去、入、行入、買, for example when saying you go to or buy things from this kind of shop.
Can refer to a small neighborhood shop or a bigger store inside a shopping mall; the exact size depends on context.
This is a neutral, everyday term. For learner use, it is safer than more technical or brand-specific vocabulary when talking about beauty retail.
